OppFi is a leading tech-enabled digital finance platform that works with banks to provide financial products and services for everyday Americans. Through a transparent and responsible platform, which includes financial inclusion and excellent customer experience, the Company supports consumers who are turned away by mainstream options to build better financial health.

We are a team of caring, innovative, and inclusive individuals who thrive in being immersed in diverse talents, expertise, perspectives, and backgrounds. Our employees approach every new challenge with an unparalleled ability to see what could be rather than settle for what is. Our business principles guide us and create an open and collaborative culture where we improve 1% every day, and the best ideas always win! We welcome individuals who want to make an impact in the financial system by facilitating credit access, expanding financial inclusion, promoting financial health, and delivering exceptional customer service.

A few other fun facts about us. OppFi is one of the top consumer-rated financial platforms online, maintaining a 4.4/5.0-star rating on Trustpilot. We are a 2025 Crain’s Fast 50™ company and were named on Built In's 2026 Best Places to Work in Chicago.

About the Job:

OppFi's Anti-Financial Crimes (AFC) Department is seeking a motivated AML Investigator to join our team. In this role, you will execute various anti-money laundering (AML) processes across our lines of business. Key responsibilities include investigating unusual activity for potential reporting, conducting thorough customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews, and assisting with other AML tasks. The ideal candidate has experience in AML investigations and will collaborate with management to ensure timely and accurate completion of critical functions.

What you'll get to do:

  • Monitor, analyze transactional activity, and conduct investigations for unusual activity including, fraud, money laundering, and other identified risks (internal reports, escalations, and external referrals).
  • Conduct research using internal and external sources to help determine if escalation is warranted.
  • Review ACH activity, web or telephone-initiated transactions for fraudulent activity.
  • Prepare and complete required reporting and dispositions accurately and timely.
  • Investigate and analyze the causes, methods, and processes of Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”)/Bank Secrecy Act (“BSA”) and fraud activities and generate fraud prevention and analysis reports.
  • Investigate any potential OFAC hits and escalate issues as warranted.
  • Review, process and screen for Section 314(a) watchlist requirements received from FinCEN.
  • Understands and stays current on Red Flags and industry trends related to AML/BSA and fraud.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you'll bring to the team:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Criminal Justice, Political Science, Law or a related field.
  • 3+ years relevant of AML/BSA or fraud experience including intelligence and investigative analysis, or other compliance related experience. Financial crime investigation experience preferred.
  • Empowers employees to take responsibility for their tasks and goals. Delegate responsibilities, owns accountability and accepts feedback well.
  • A combination of education and experience may meet job requirements.
  • Experience and/or exposure to financial institution AML/fraud investigations
  • Basic working knowledge of AML/BSA/fraud regulatory compliance processes and procedures.
  • Must have solid research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Must have good writing skills and be able to translate complex situations to easily understood narratives.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills; detail-oriented and self-motivated.
  • Excellent problem resolution skills.
  • Excellent skills in EXCEL, PowerPoint, JIRA. SQL abilities are a plus.
  • Proven ability to build strong relationships, working with all levels with both internal and external customers. Enthusiasm for learning new things and taking on new projects.
  • A passion for improving the lives of consumers through OppFi products.

Reports to: BSA/AML Team Lead

Job Level: Associate

Candidates are encouraged to discuss compensation expectations during the hiring process. In addition to base pay, the total compensation package includes eligibility and potential for performance-based bonuses and equity grants dependent upon the role and job level.

OppFi offers a flexible, remote environment, 401(k) matching program, and generous paid time off. Other benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, and tuition reimbursement. Additional benefits include DoorDash DashPass, Figo pet insurance, Rocket Lawyer, and access to LinkedIn Learning. OppFi also offers Fringe, a lifestyle benefits platform that allows employees to decide how to spend rewards from dozens of vendors like Uber, DoorDash, and UrbanSitter.

McKesson partners with pharmaceutical manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, governments, and other organizations in healthcare to help provide the right medicines, medical products, and healthcare services to the right patients at the right time, safely and cost-effectively.

United by our I2CARE shared principles, our employees work every day to innovate and deliver opportunities that make our customers and partners more successful - all for the better health of patients. We welcome and encourage veterans, individuals with disabilities and others with diverse perspectives to join our growing team. Your unique perspective and experience are valuable assets that can translate into a rewarding career path with us.

Position Description

McKesson is seeking a Specialist, Medicaid Portal & Contract Administrator.

The Specialist, Medicaid Portal & Contract Administrator plays a critical role within our Payor Access team, supporting payer contract compliance, including credentialing, recredentialing, contract maintenance, and reimbursement adherence. This position serves as a key liaison between the Contracting, Compliance, Quality, and Operations teams, ensuring accurate documentation, regulatory alignment, and efficient portal management to support organizational objectives.

Enrollment & Credentialing

Contract & Compliance Tracking

Regulatory Monitoring & Issue Resolution

Corporate Compliance Support

Documentation & Records Management

Develop and maintain a comprehensive, secure repository of corporate documentation, including:

  • Ownership and governance records (board and director documentation).

About the job SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.

The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.

Responsibilities:

  • Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.
  • Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.
  • Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.
  • Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.
  • Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.
  • Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.
  • Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.
  • Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

  • 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.
  • Understanding of banking data environment.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.
  • Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.
  • Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.
  • In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.
  • Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

Note about Hiring Timeline: Our team is proactively posting this position and we aim to hire someone based in North America later in 2025

About the Role

Abilitie is looking for a Client Business Director who is ready to take full ownership of client relationships, navigate complexity confidently, and push the boundaries of leadership development. In this high-impact role, you will deliver our flagship programs to Fortune 500 clients, ensuring that each engagement not only meets expectations but redefines them. You will lead withstrategic insight, proactive problem-solving, and relentless accountability, balancing program design with consultative selling to drive client growth and retention.

This is not a passive account management role—it’s an opportunity to own outcomes, build deep trust, and create long-term partnerships that grow both our clients' businesses and our own. Reporting to a Senior Business Partner, this role demands precision in execution, adaptability in approach, and a solutions-oriented mindset in every interaction.

If you thrive in high-stakes environments where success is earned through influence, integrity, and ownership, this could be the perfect role for you.

Who You Are

  • A Relationship Builder: You instinctively understand how to cultivate trust, advocate for clients, and balance their needs with business objectives. You measure success not just in sales, but in long-term impact.Experience within the Leadership & Development space is beneficial in building credibility with clients.
  • An Opportunity Seeker with High EQ: You read the room, sense when to push forward and when to step back, and know that timing and delivery are just as important as the message itself.A background in consultative sales is extremely beneficial for success.
  • A Proactive Communicator: You don’t wait for questions—you anticipate them. You staythree steps ahead to create a seamless experience for clients and teammates alike.
  • An Accountability Champion: You take ownership of outcomes—both the wins and the challenges. If something goes wrong, you fix it. If something goes right, you build on it. Project management experience is highly beneficial.
  • A Curious Learner: You seek feedback, embrace new ideas, and stay focused on the long game—knowing that ego has no place in true partnership.

What You Will Do

  • Own the Client Experience: Manage a portfolio of clients, ensuring that every engagement delivers tangible impact and strengthens long-term partnerships.
  • Drive Growth Through Trust: Expand client relationships by consistently providing value—not by pushing unnecessary sales, but by positioning the right solutions at the right time.
  • Lead Complex Global Programs: Coordinate large-scale leadership development initiatives, working closely with senior executives, facilitators, and internal teams to ensure flawless execution.
  • Provide Thought Leadership: Collaborate with clients to design high-impact leadership programs that leverage our award-winning simulations and methodologies.
  • Engage Senior-Level Stakeholders: Act as a trusted strategic partner by working directly with HR and business leaders at some of the world’s most recognized organizations.
  • Execute with Excellence: From event planning to marketing research, no task is too big or too small—every detail matters.
  • Solve Problems Before They Happen: Approach every challenge with a solutions-first mindset, ensuring that obstacles become opportunities.

This Role Is Likely Not A Match If

  • You prefer to be told what to do rather than take initiative. This role requires a self-starter who thrives on accountability and ownership.
  • You’re uncomfortable navigating ambiguity. Clients will have unique and evolving needs—there is no script to follow.
  • You see sales as a transaction rather than a partnership. Our approach is rooted in trust, not quick wins.
  • You avoid difficult conversations. Success in this role requires delivering hard truths with tact and confidence.
  • You struggle with feedback and iteration. Growth comes from learning, adjusting, and improving—both personally and professionally.
  • You need a rigid structure to be effective. This role demands adaptability, creative problem-solving, and flexibility in the face of changing priorities.

Unique Perks

  • Fully paid employee medical benefits, which include HSA and FSA options, dental, vision, STD/LTD, and Life Insurance as well as a Matching 401K.
  • Unlimited PTO, parental leave, and sabbatical program
  • Learning Opportunities – Our simulations are typically accompanied by world-class professional development, which will almost certainly benefit your own career development.
  • Great Company Culture – We’ve been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the Best Workplaces in America for 2 years running.
  • Competitive Pay – We hire great folks and our salaries are set with that in mind.
  • High Impact – As a valued Abilitie employee, each contribution you make will have high visibility and drive real business.
  • Freedom/Responsibility – Our company is built around empowering individuals (both as our mission and internally) to be their best selves. This means our employees can work in a way that brings them energy and drives value!

Who We Are

Abilitie is an award-winning leadership development organization, recognized by Inc Magazine as one of the 2019, 2020 & 2022 Best Workplaces in America and one of the 2020 Fastest Growing Companies in America. Check out more of our awards and recognitions here: https://www.abilitie.com/awards-recognition/

We create world-class experiences that inspire, shape, and develop through highly differentiated learning programs, tools for self-discovery, and networks that expand opportunities. Our team-based business competitions which engage aspiring leaders in an active, learn-by-doing environment are used by over 100 Fortune 500 clients, including Marriott, Coca-Cola, GE, and Southwest Airlines.

Our employees are a diverse and inclusive team of passionate, hardworking individuals. Abilitie is committed to creating an environment where our employees can do the best work of their lives. As part of this commitment to equitable opportunity and inclusion, we encourage all qualified individuals inclusive of all genders, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations, ages, socio-economic backgrounds, religions, and beliefs to apply to join our A-Player team.

The Sr Financial Analyst – Cloud plays a central role in planning, forecasting, reporting, and accounting for Cloud costs, one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important investment categories in our Technology portfolio. This is a data-rich role where questions are often open-ended and the path to an answer is not always obvious. The right candidate enjoys working through complex datasets, building scalable models and pipelines, and turning ambiguity into clear, actionable insights, while maintaining the rigor and accuracy required for month-end close.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in both finance and technology, thrives in fast-moving environments, and operates with a high level of ownership. Utilize advanced financial modeling techniques to create detailed forecasts and provide variance analysis to explain key financial trends. At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

The Risk Policy Specialist is an experienced individual contributor who combines deep investigative research expertise and strategic insight to support internal stakeholders, product growth, and high-profile clients. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role serves as a trusted subject-matter expert across multiple domains, including trust & safety, regulatory and policy trends, and the payments ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will lead complex research initiatives, evaluate and synthesize information from diverse sources, and play a central role in advising internal analyst teams and clients on complex regulatory topics.

What You'll Do:

Research, Intelligence, and Client Deliverables

  • Lead and conduct in-depth investigative research to support client deliverables, intelligence reports, proofs of concept, and ad hoc research requests.
  • Evaluate, analyze, and synthesize information from diverse regulatory, and open sources to provide clear narratives regarding platform risk and emerging abuse patterns.
  • Serve as a senior reviewer for high-priority reports and data deliverables, editing others’ writing in keeping with organizational style to ensure accuracy, clarity, and actionable insights.
  • Partner closely with Data Integrity teams to map new risk networks and conduct ongoing network integrity checks to ensure data accuracy.

Legal Analysis & Escalation Support

  • Perform comprehensive legal and regulatory research across a wide variety of high-risk subject areas and jurisdictions (e.g., healthcare, telemedicine, financial services, gambling, adult content).
  • Decisively answer internal analyst questions, provide final risk decisions for clients, and serve as a central point of contact for complex, high-risk escalations.

Knowledge Management and Subject-Matter Expertise

  • Help design, build, and maintain internal knowledge bases and team-specific resource libraries with an emphasis on usability and consistency.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert for payments-related risk, including payment facilitation models, merchant risk, evolving fintech/regulatory expectations, and social media and e-commerce platforms.
  • Track and interpret regulatory, enforcement, and industry developments, integrating insights into team resources, training materials, and workflows.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Represent the Research function in internal and external meetings, advising Sales and Product teams on ecosystem trends, product opportunities, or policy limitations.
  • Mentor and support junior researchers, analysts, and specialists through formal peer review, coaching, and the development of training materials.

What You'll Bring:

  • Typically 4+ years of experience in research, legal compliance, risk operations, intelligence, or a related field.
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to adjust complex writing for diverse audiences (from internal analysts to executives and clients).
  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the confidence to make definitive decisions under pressure.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Google Workspace, Confluence, Microsoft Excel/Sheets, standard research or monitoring platforms, and common use AI tools.
  • Exhibit a growth mindset by being open to feedback, embracing change, and collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with SQL for querying large datasets, data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Databricks), or Python.
  • Hands-on experience utilizing advanced Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) techniques to uncover complex threat networks across social media and payments platforms.
  • Prior experience with: traditional financial/fintech regulations, FDA/FTC compliance within the healthcare or pharmaceutical industries, or other regulated industries such as gambling, firearms, and tobacco.

We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We're looking for an experienced Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team on an initial three-month contract.

You'll work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, delivering high-impact reporting, supporting acquisition integrations, and helping build the next generation of our commercial data platform.

This is not a traditional reporting role. We're looking for not only someone who can quickly become a trusted delivery partner for Revenue Operations, independently leading complex analytics projects from requirements through to production, but also someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, works with minimal direction, and takes ownership for delivering complete, high-quality solutions.

What you'll do:

  • Project Leadership: Lead complex Business Intelligence projects from discovery through delivery with minimal supervision.
  • Tableau Dashboards: Design, build, and optimise dashboards used by senior leadership and Revenue Operations.
  • Snowflake Modeling: Develop and maintain high-quality SQL models within Snowflake.
  • Executive Reporting: Work closely with Revenue Operations to deliver reporting across pipeline, bookings, ARR, CARR, churn, expansion, forecasting, and sales performance.
  • M&A Integration: Support the integration of newly acquired businesses into Shiftmove's GTM reporting ecosystem, ensuring data is accurately mapped into our existing Snowflake and Tableau environment.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Salesforce administrators and business stakeholders to ensure reporting accurately reflects commercial processes.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Validate business rules, investigate data discrepancies, and maintain trusted reporting.
  • Documentation: Document data models, business logic, and reporting standards to ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and self-service capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first three months you will have:

  • Successfully delivered one or more strategic GTM reporting initiatives.
  • Become a trusted analytics partner to the Revenue Operations team.
  • Supported the integration of acquisition data into our reporting environment.
  • Improved the quality, performance or maintainability of existing Tableau reporting.
  • Reduced manual reporting effort through automation and process improvements.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Professional Experience: Multiple years of experience in Business Intelligence or Analytics roles.
  • SaaS Analytics: Strong commercial analytics experience within a SaaS business.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) Support: Demonstrated experience supporting Go-to-Market organisations, including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.
  • Tableau Expertise: Expert-level Tableau development.
  • Advanced SQL & Snowflake: Advanced SQL skills with experience working in Snowflake.
  • Salesforce & Data Models: Strong understanding of Salesforce reporting and commercial data models.
  • Executive Reporting: Experience delivering executive reporting for sales performance, pipeline, forecasting, renewals, churn, and expansion.
  • Stakeholder Management: Comfortable working directly with senior stakeholders and translating business questions into analytical solutions.
  • Project Ownership: Able to independently own projects from initial requirements through to successful delivery.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical thinking with excellent attention to detail.
  • Languages: English C1

Why join us?

  • Build products with real-world impact: We solve complex, everyday problems for thousands of businesses across Europe, replacing manual, fragmented fleet operations with data-driven, intelligent solutions people truly rely on.
  • Scale something meaningful: We’re a profitable, PE-backed scale-up with strong fundamentals and a clear ambition (1M vehicles by 2027), offering a rare mix of stability, ownership, and pace.
  • Work in a truly international, collaborative environment: With 40+ nationalities, English as our working language, and teams across Europe, collaboration and shared ownership are part of how we work every day.
  • Grow with autonomy and trust: We invest heavily in product, data, and people – giving you the space to take responsibility, contribute ideas, challenge others, and do your best work while helping shape how we scale.

We mean it!

With over 40 nationalities, we are united by our dedication and a shared belief in our purpose: to simplify mobility operations for businesses. Different backgrounds, career paths, and perspectives are what make the work better. What we care about is simple: people who take responsibility, make it happen, and care deeply about the work. If you're unsure whether you fit, apply anyway. And if you need anything adjusted during the process, just tell us, and we'll make it work!

raw.title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst (Contract)
raw.excerpt: Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure.
raw.description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We're looking for an experienced Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team on an initial three-month contract.

You'll work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, delivering high-impact reporting, supporting acquisition integrations, and helping build the next generation of our commercial data platform.

This is not a traditional reporting role. We're looking for not only someone who can quickly become a trusted delivery partner for Revenue Operations, independently leading complex analytics projects from requirements through to production, but also someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, works with minimal direction, and takes ownership for delivering complete, high-quality solutions.

What you'll do:

  • Project Leadership: Lead complex Business Intelligence projects from discovery through delivery with minimal supervision.
  • Tableau Dashboards: Design, build, and optimise dashboards used by senior leadership and Revenue Operations.
  • Snowflake Modeling: Develop and maintain high-quality SQL models within Snowflake.
  • Executive Reporting: Work closely with Revenue Operations to deliver reporting across pipeline, bookings, ARR, CARR, churn, expansion, forecasting, and sales performance.
  • M&A Integration: Support the integration of newly acquired businesses into Shiftmove's GTM reporting ecosystem, ensuring data is accurately mapped into our existing Snowflake and Tableau environment.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Salesforce administrators and business stakeholders to ensure reporting accurately reflects commercial processes.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Validate business rules, investigate data discrepancies, and maintain trusted reporting.
  • Documentation: Document data models, business logic, and reporting standards to ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and self-service capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first three months you will have:

  • Successfully delivered one or more strategic GTM reporting initiatives.
  • Become a trusted analytics partner to the Revenue Operations team.
  • Supported the integration of acquisition data into our reporting environment.
  • Improved the quality, performance or maintainability of existing Tableau reporting.
  • Reduced manual reporting effort through automation and process improvements.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Professional Experience: Multiple years of experience in Business Intelligence or Analytics roles.
  • SaaS Analytics: Strong commercial analytics experience within a SaaS business.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) Support: Demonstrated experience supporting Go-to-Market organisations, including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.
  • Tableau Expertise: Expert-level Tableau development.
  • Advanced SQL & Snowflake: Advanced SQL skills with experience working in Snowflake.
  • Salesforce & Data Models: Strong understanding of Salesforce reporting and commercial data models.
  • Executive Reporting: Experience delivering executive reporting for sales performance, pipeline, forecasting, renewals, churn, and expansion.
  • Stakeholder Management: Comfortable working directly with senior stakeholders and translating business questions into analytical solutions.
  • Project Ownership: Able to independently own projects from initial requirements through to successful delivery.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical thinking with excellent attention to detail.
  • Languages: English C1

Why join us?

  • Build products with real-world impact: We solve complex, everyday problems for thousands of businesses across Europe, replacing manual, fragmented fleet operations with data-driven, intelligent solutions people truly rely on.
  • Scale something meaningful: We’re a profitable, PE-backed scale-up with strong fundamentals and a clear ambition (1M vehicles by 2027), offering a rare mix of stability, ownership, and pace.
  • Work in a truly international, collaborative environment: With 40+ nationalities, English as our working language, and teams across Europe, collaboration and shared ownership are part of how we work every day.
  • Grow with autonomy and trust: We invest heavily in product, data, and people – giving you the space to take responsibility, contribute ideas, challenge others, and do your best work while helping shape how we scale.

We mean it!

With over 40 nationalities, we are united by our dedication and a shared belief in our purpose: to simplify mobility operations for businesses. Different backgrounds, career paths, and perspectives are what make the work better. What we care about is simple: people who take responsibility, make it happen, and care deeply about the work. If you're unsure whether you fit, apply anyway. And if you need anything adjusted during the process, just tell us, and we'll make it work!

As a Solution Architect, its your job to ascertain that envisaged solutions become reality. Taking this client-facing role, you are equally comfortable in deep-dive technical workshops and in board-level sales presentations. Having earned your stripes in designing web-based architectures, you have no problem finding the scope in large-scale, complex projects.

To the development team, you are the vital mainstay during processes of implementation. To customers and partners, you are the expert liaison with a keen feel for their needs. Meet the job

You will be part of the development team in which you will fulfill a leading role only gained by excellent performance. Talking highly specific technical details as well as discussing general business outcomes, you comfortably translate customer requirements into a distinguished design. You dedicate yourself to security, deployment, performance, caching, sizing, scalability and serviceability.

You know our projects are to be delivered according to briefing, time and budget, but you also know our technicians need their space to build the solutions youve defined. By creating structure and clear explanations, you provide guidance and oversight to your team.

Also part of the job is creating technical architecture documentation; working with the QA lead to define the test strategy; leading DevOps to define and implement CI/CD pipelines; ensuring that implementations meet non-functional requirements, and you will be travelling a significant amount of the time, spending time on-site during the inception phase and when providing training and workshops.

How about you

  • You have a demonstrable understanding of Service Oriented Architectures (SOA), as well as Micro-Services Architecture;
  • JavaScript frameworks, MVC patterns and principles of REST APIs, ideally including RAML and/or OpenAPI, are second nature to you;

  • Are familiar with architectural patterns, such as Microservices, CQRS, event sourcing;
  • Have experience with server virtualization and containers technology such as Docker, VMWare, HyperV;

Job Title: Chef de projet clinique associé , Associate Clinical Project Manager

Pour être éligible à ce poste, vous devez résider dans le même pays où se trouve le poste.

Chef de projet clinique associé

Tous les domaines thérapeutiques

Le chef de projet clinique associé est un membre de l’équipe de projet principale responsable de la réalisation des études cliniques afin de répondre aux exigences contractuelles conformément aux PON, aux politiques et aux pratiques. Le Projet Leadership d’IQVIA est une équipe mondiale de professionnels dédiés au partenariat avec nos clients pour faire avancer les soins de santé et permettre des percées dans le domaine médical qui font progresser les options de soins de santé et de traitement des patients dans le monde entier. Le Projet Leadership se concentre sur la réalisation réussie de projets en appliquant un ensemble robuste de processus de gestion de projet conçus pour permettre la productivité et la qualité, ce qui se traduit par de solides performances financières et la satisfaction des clients.

Votre objectif principal sera de favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle et le leadership stratégique auprès de nos fournisseurs tiers et de nos clients, ainsi que de mener vos propres petites études, dans le cadre de votre développement.

Les collaborateurs clés sont le chef de projet pour le partenariat dans la gestion globale du projet, le responsable clinique pour la gestion du centre, l’analyste en gestion de projet pour la coordination, le suivi et l’analyse financière du projet, et le responsable de l’activation du centre en tant qu’expert en matière de démarrage.

Il s’agit d’un rôle important et de haut niveau au sein de notre organisation d’opérations cliniques de recherche et développement. La taille et l’empreinte mondiale d’IQVIA vous offriront l’étendue des opportunités nécessaires pour développer votre carrière.

Généralement, dans le cadre du travail sur un ou deux projets, ou sur un programme, les responsabilités peuvent inclure :

  • Contribuer aux plans de gestion intégrés de l’étude avec l’équipe principale et/ou la sous-équipe du projet et assurer l’utilisation cohérente des outils d’étude, du matériel de formation et le respect des processus, politiques et procédures standard.

  • Anticiper les risques et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’atténuation pour les activités assignées et collaborer avec le chef de projet et d’autres responsables fonctionnels dans le cadre des efforts de résolution des problèmes.

  • Collaborer avec d’autres groupes fonctionnels au sein de l’entreprise, si nécessaire, pour soutenir la réalisation des étapes clés et gérer les problèmes et les obstacles liés à l’étude.

  • Aider le chef de projet à préparer/présenter les informations sur le projet et/ou sur la sous-équipe de manière proactive aux parties prenantes externes.

  • Assurer la qualité du projet en identifiant les risques et les problèmes liés à la qualité, en répondant aux problèmes soulevés par les membres de la sous-équipe du projet et en collaborant avec le chef de projet pour planifier/mettre en œuvre des plans d’action correctifs et préventifs appropriés.

  • Diriger les efforts d’une sous-équipe de projet, assumer la responsabilité de la gestion de la collaboration croisée de la sous-équipe pour soutenir la réalisation des jalons et gérer les problèmes et les obstacles.

  • Soutenir le chef de projet pour assurer la réussite financière du projet.

  • Prévoir et identifier les opportunités d’accélérer les activités afin de générer des revenus en partenariat avec le chef de projet principal.

  • Identifier les changements de portée et collaborer avec le chef de projet pour gérer le processus de contrôle des changements, si nécessaire.

  • Le cas échéant, en tant que gestionnaire des fournisseurs d’un projet :

  • Élaborer le plan de gestion des fournisseurs au niveau de l’étude, y compris les produits livrables et les étapes, les accords sur les niveaux de service (ANS) et les rapports, le plan de communication et de remontée des problèmes, la gestion des risques, le plan de classement (dossier électronique permanent de l’essai, eTMF), la stratégie de fourniture d’équipements, la formation des fournisseurs, le plan de transition des membres clés de l’équipe, l’accès au système.

  • Servir de contact principal avec le client pour les progrès, la gestion des risques et la gouvernance des fournisseurs tiers.

  • Gérer et suivre les performances des fournisseurs par le biais d’indicateurs clés de performance, de livrables et de jalons et préparer/présenter de manière proactive l’état/les performances des fournisseurs tiers aux parties prenantes internes.

  • S’assurer que le budget de l’étude réalisée par les fournisseurs tiers est géré de manière proactive, y compris les changements de portée, et que les systèmes financiers sont précis.

• Peut agir en tant que chef de projet principal dans le cadre d’études petites et simples ou en tant que contact de secours pour le projet auprès du client :

oFixer les objectifs des sous-équipes du projet, conformément au contrat, à la stratégie et à l’approche convenus, communiquer et évaluer efficacement les performances.

oSurveiller les progrès par rapport au contrat et préparer/présenter les informations sur le projet et/ou sur la sous-équipe de manière proactive aux parties prenantes internes.

CONNAISSANCES, COMPÉTENCES ET APTITUDES REQUISES

  • Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe et 2 ans d’expérience en recherche clinique.

  • Au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience préalable en gestion de projets et en opérations cliniques; ou une combinaison équivalente d’études, de formation et d’expérience.

Vous devrez travailler directement avec des départements, des équipes, des fonctions de support et des parties prenantes d'IQVIA situés partout au Canada et à travers le monde, par conséquent, une connaissance fonctionnelle de l'anglais, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral, est nécessaire à l'exercice des fonctions de ce poste.

To be eligible for this position, you must reside in the same country where the job is located.

Job Overview
Associate Project Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, liaising with clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Associate Project Lead is a member of the core project team responsible for project delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with SOPs, policies and practices. Clinical Project Management is focused on project delivery, productivity and quality resulting in strong financial performance and customer satisfaction. The Associate Project Lead support the efforts of CPM to drive operational excellence and strategic leadership with our customers. Associate Project Leads may run their own studies, as part of their development.

Essential Functions
• Provide input in to the development of integrated study management plans with the core project team and/or sub-team.
• Accountable for assigned portion of clinical studies as per the contract while optimizing speed, quality and cost of delivery and ensuring consistent use of study tools and training materials and compliance with standard processes, policies and procedures.
• Set objectives of project sub-team(s), according to agreed upon contract, strategy and approach, effectively communicate and assess performance.
• Collaborate with other functional groups within the company where necessary to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.
• Monitor progress against contract and prepare/present project and/or sub-team information proactively to internal stakeholders. Support the project leader to prepare/present project and/or sub-team information proactively to external stakeholders.
• Identify risk (positive and negative) and contingencies and partner with project leader in problem solving and resolution efforts.
• Achieve project quality by identifying quality risks and issues, responding to issues raised by project sub-team members and partner with project leader planning/implementing appropriate corrective and preventative action plans.
• May serve as primary (for small projects) or back-up project contact with customer.
• Lead the efforts of a project sub-team, responsible for managing cross-collaboration of the sub-team to support milestone achievement and to manage issues and obstacles.
• Support the project leader in ensuring the financial success of the project.
• Forecast and identify opportunities to accelerate activities to bring revenue forward in partnership with the senior project leader.
• Identify changes in scope and partner with project leader to manage change control process as necessary.
• Identify lessons learned and implement best practices.
• May be assigned as the primary contact for vendors leading project vendor management and vendor management related activities as per project requirements

Qualifications
• Associate's Degree In life sciences or related field required Req Or
• Bachelor's Degree In life sciences or related field required Req
• 2 years clinical research experience. Req
• Requires intermediate level knowledge of principles, theories, and concepts of a job area, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience.; Req
• Knowledge of clinical trials - Knowledge of clinical trial conduct, and skill in applying applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e. ICH GCP and relevant local laws, regulations and guidelines, towards clinical trial conduct. Broad protocol knowledge, therapeutic knowledge desired.;
• Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. Strong presentation skills.
• Problem solving - Strong problem solving skills.
• Organisation - Planning, time management and prioritization skills. Ability to organize resources needed to accomplish tasks, set objectives and provide clear direction to others, experience planning activities in advance and taking account of possible changing circumstances.
• Prioritisation - Ability to handle conflicting priorities.
• Quality - Attention to detail and accuracy in work. Results-oriented approach to work towards delivery and output.
• IT Skills - Good software and computer skills, including MS Office applications including but not limited to Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Collaboration - Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients. Strong customer service skills.
• Cross-collaboration - Ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.
• Finances - Good understanding of project financials.

You will be required to work directly with IQVIA departments, teams, support functions and stakeholders located across Canada and around the world therefore, a functional knowledge of English, both written and spoken, is necessary to perform the duties of this position.

Orchata, Who?


We may sound sweet, but the truth is...This is just a cover and we’re on a not-so-secret mission.

Orchata’s team is working everyday to give millions of local businesses a new opportunity to grow and get into the e-commerce train; a train that has been mostly occupied by large retailers and millionaires companies. Well, no more. Orchata wasn’t a dream for too long, because our team is full of creators and achievers!

Nowadays, we empower local businesses from LATAM with technology, and they keep your house full of your favorite products and the same trust that has represented their brands during the years (and decades). Now this sounds sweet, right? But sweet isn’t good enough yet! And we need to keep growing our team with passionate doers. We won’t be expecting you to have a NASA career, but we expect you to dream beyond Jupiter.If you feel related to these couple of lines, then this is a sign..


About the Role


Orchata is looking for a self-motivated and disruptive Product Designer with excellent communication skills and a desire to work in a fast-paced, successful startup environment.As Product Designer, you will craft and orchestrate compelling user experiences which create meaningful and life lasting connections between Orchata and customers. We are looking for a person with strong experience as UX/UI designer, with a high level of curiosity. We don’t want you to build another product, but THE product. This is the app of the future. If you have built many interesting and sophisticated interfaces that push the needle from status quo, then you will be a great fit in our team!


What You'll Do


  • Own design problems end-to-end, from initial concept through shipping and beyond.

  • Gather and understand business & user needs.

  • Build out detailed annotated wireframes.

  • High/low fidelity prototypes.

  • Wide range of strategic UX/Product deliverables.

  • Proactive ability of approaching the end-consumer to get clarification of problem statements and turn the feedback loops into meaningful ideas and arrangements.
  • Transform ideas, business opportunities, research, and creative vision into tangible assets that provide clear, usable, useful, and desirable outcomes for users.
  • Work closely with the Product Manager to iterate on the design and implementation of our product to drive the best digital experiences through all phases of product development, ship, and iterate.
  • Effectively act on feedback, user testing results and learning's to improve assets, products, and services.
  • Be a passionate advocate for the user, ground ideas in data driven solutions by partnering with our User Experience

What the Candidate Will Need

  • 4+ years of experience designing consumer facing applications, websites and mobile experiences


Required skills

  • Ability to simplify and turn complex interactions into intuitive user experiences

  • Exceptional skills in ideation sketching, brainstorming, UX & prototyping software

  • Experience in mobile web and/ or native mobile development

  • Fluency with design tools, most notably Sketch, Invision, Figma and/or other UX & prototyping software

  • Demonstrated design and UX sensibilities

  • Awareness of cross-browser compatibility issues

  • Clear and confident communicator with an affinity for visual storytelling

  • Portfolio showing breadth of UI/UX Design work


Extra magic points if you have

  • Fluency in HTML, CSS, Javascript and related web technologies

  • Technical knowledge: UI with the latest technologies: React, Redux, Sass, ES2016

  • Previous experience working on e-commerce platforms or SaaS.

raw.description:
Controller Job Description

Company: Pro Coffee Gear
Location: Remote (Global)
Employment Type: Full-time

About Us

Pro Coffee Gear is a rapidly growing e-commerce company specializing in espresso machines and related parts. Our passion for coffee drives us to provide top-tier products and exceptional customer service to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. With a dedication to quality and innovation, we aim to elevate the coffee experience for our customers and become a leading authority in the industry. As a dynamic and diverse team, we value collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement, and we're committed to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Controller to join our leadership team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in financial management, reporting, and analysis, with the ability to drive financial strategy and provide executive-level insights to support business growth and decision-making.

Responsibilities

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Oversee all aspects of financial operations including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Payroll management
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes with accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare and present comprehensive financial statements, management reports, and board-level presentations
  • Develop and maintain robust financial controls, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance and accuracy

Strategic Analysis & Planning

  • Provide strategic financial analysis and recommendations to executive leadership
  • Lead annual budgeting and forecasting processes, including variance analysis and performance metrics
  • Develop sophisticated financial models and pro forma analyses for business initiatives, product launches, and strategic investments
  • Conduct profitability analysis by product line, customer segment, and business unit

Systems Integration & Process Optimization

  • Ensure seamless integration of inventory management, e-commerce platforms, and payment systems with the general ledger
  • Lead ERP system optimization and financial system implementations
  • Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial dashboards

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax professionals, and regulatory bodies
  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, tax regulations, and reporting requirements
  • Oversee internal controls and SOX compliance (if applicable)
  • Identify and mitigate financial risks across the organization

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and mentor finance team members, fostering professional growth and development
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, sales, marketing, and executive teams
  • Provide financial training and support to non-finance departments

Requirements

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required
  • CPA certification strongly preferred
  • Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or MBA preferred

Experience

  • Minimum 7-10 years of progressive accounting and finance experience
  • At least 3-5 years in a Controller or senior financial management role
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail, or inventory-based businesses strongly preferred
  • Public accounting experience with Big 4 or mid-tier firms is a plus

Technical Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, and financial modeling
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite, QuickBooks Enterprise, SAP, etc.)
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems
  • Strong understanding of business intelligence and reporting tools

Core Competencies

  • Deep understanding of US GAAP and IFRS accounting principles
  • Comprehensive knowledge of US tax system, regulations, and reporting deadlines
  • Proven track record of successful month-end and year-end close processes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
  • Experience in process improvement and change management
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for executive-level reporting

Work Requirements

  • Must align with Central Time business hours for collaboration with US-based team
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, remote environment with minimal supervision
  • Strong project management skills and ability to handle multiple priorities

Benefits

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding company
  • Remote work with flexible hours, allowing for healthy work-life balance
  • Goal-oriented work culture providing autonomy and opportunities for personal and professional development

How to Apply

If you're an experienced finance leader with a passion for driving business growth and a love for coffee, we want to hear from you! To apply at Pro Coffee Gear, please submit your resume along with a cover letter highlighting your relevant controller experience and achievements. Join us in shaping the future of coffee and contributing to our company's continued growth and success.

Please note: All applicants must submit their CV in English. CVs in other languages will automatically be disqualified.

At Pro Coffee Gear, we believe in the strength of diversity and equal opportunities for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global leader in mobile payment and digital content monetization. We're looking for a Native PHP Developer with 5 to 10 years of experience building and maintaining high-throughput, production-grade backend systems. You should have strong command of core (vanilla) PHP, not just framework-driven development, and direct experience with transaction-heavy, mission-critical applications. Your Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain robust backend services in native PHP (7/8), with clean, testable and well-documented code.
  • Build and optimize high-volume transaction and billing workflows, ensuring reliability, idempotency and data integrity at scale.
  • Develop and maintain REST/SOAP APIs for operator, merchant and third-party integrations.
  • Work with relational databases (MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, indexing and performance tuning.
  • Integrate with external systems and gateways (payment, messaging/SMS, USSD, carrier connections, monitoring, billing).
  • Implement asynchronous processing using message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka) and caching layers (Redis/Memcached).
  • Ensure application security, resilience and observability (logging, metrics, alerting) in a high-availability context.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and Git-based workflows.
  • Collaborate with product, ops and QA teams to ship, monitor and continuously improve services in production.

  • Expert-level native/core PHP (7/8), solid OOP, design patterns, and clean architecture.
  • Proven experience with high-throughput, transactional backend systems (mandatory).
  • Strong SQL skills (MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL): modeling, optimization, debugging.
  • Solid experience designing and consuming REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Comfort with Linux environments, Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Familiarity with message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka), caching (Redis), and asynchronous processing.
  • Good understanding of application security and data integrity in sensitive/financial contexts.
  • Fluent English and the ability to work autonomously across timezones.

Nice To Have:

  • Exposure to payment, billing, or telecom platforms (DCB, Premium SMS, USSD, Mobile Money, LPM).
  • Experience with a modern PHP framework (Symfony, Laravel) alongside native PHP.
  • Docker / containerization and basic CI/CD tooling.
  • Familiarity with monitoring/logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Graylog).
  • Awareness of PCI-DSS or other security/compliance standards.

Our client is a well-established, international player shaping the future of mobile payments and digital monetization, connecting operators, merchants and brands across dozens of markets. You'll work on platforms that process transactions at real scale, in a dynamic and fast-paced environment that values autonomy, ownership and technical excellence, where your contributions directly impact revenue-critical systems used worldwide.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced .NET Full Stack Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems built on Microsoft technology stacks. This role spans the full engineering lifecycle — requirements analysis, architectural design, hands-on implementation, code review, deployment, and post-release support — with particular emphasis on building scalable APIs, responsive front-end applications, and cloud-integrated services. The ideal candidate will combine strong backend expertise in C# and .NET Core with hands-on experience developing modern front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks, and will be comfortable deploying solutions into Azure or AWS environments while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, observability, and operational reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide comprehensive end-to-end design, development, and advanced technical troubleshooting for enterprise-level web applications, from initial discovery through long-term operational ownership.

  • Build modern, responsive front-end applications using Angular, React, or similar frameworks, ensuring excellent user experience, accessibility, and performance across browsers and devices.
  • Develop and optimize relational database schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and complex queries in SQL Server, with attention to performance, locking behavior, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce thorough architecture and technical design documentation, ensuring alignment with performance, security, compliance, and operational standards of the enterprise.
  • Participate in system design discussions and ensure that development consistently aligns with enterprise architecture constraints, technology road-maps, and platform standards.
  • Implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, and modern identity management services such as Azure AD or Okta.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration, automated builds, infrastructure-as-code practices, and reliable deployment processes across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Perform thorough root-cause analysis and methodically troubleshoot production issues, working to restore service quickly while ensuring long-term operational stability.
  • Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural gaps, and proactively propose and implement well-scoped improvements with measurable benefits.
  • Collaborate fully in Agile/Scrum environments — including planning, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives — to deliver incremental, high-quality releases on a predictable cadence.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of systems, APIs, integration workflows, and operational runbooks so that the team can scale and onboard new engineers efficiently.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software development experience building production-grade enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles, data structures, design patterns, and end-to-end system design.
  • Advanced proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Web API, including familiarity with dependency injection, async/await patterns, and middleware design.
  • Hands-on experience developing front-end applications using Angular, React, or similar component-driven frameworks.
  • Strong SQL skills with deep, hands-on experience working with SQL Server, including stored procedures, query plans, and performance tuning.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD tooling and Git-based version control systems, including branching strategies and release workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying applications to Azure or AWS cloud environments, including managed services and identity integration.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues calmly and effectively.
  • Experience working in large enterprise-scale environments where reliability, security, and audit-ability are first-class concerns.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Practical experience designing and operating microservices architectures in production.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based deployment patterns.
  • Exposure to distributed system design principles, including eventual consistency, idempotency, and circuit breakers.
  • Experience implementing automated testing frameworks across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps or similar DevOps platforms for pipeline orchestration and release management.

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Trinidad and Tobago (Remote)

Job Summary:

A Data Scientist is responsible for analyzing complex datasets to extract insights, build predictive models, and support data-driven decision-making.

Job Description

  • Data Collection & Cleaning Gather and preprocess data from various sources to ensure accuracy.
  • Statistical Analysis & Modeling Apply machine learning algorithms and statistical techniques to uncover patterns.
  • Data Visualization & Reporting Present findings using dashboards and reports for business stakeholders.
  • Big Data Processing Work with large datasets using tools like Hadoop, Spark, and cloud platforms.
  • Collaboration & Strategy Work with cross-functional teams to align data initiatives with business goals.
  • Data Governance & Security Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and best practices.

Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and data visualization tools.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and AI algorithms.
  • Experience with big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark, TensorFlow).
  • Knowledge of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Advanced understanding of statistical analysis and predictive modeling.
  • Ability to communicate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working within banking industry is an asset.

Educational Requirements

  • A bachelors degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, or a related field.
  • A masters degree or Ph.D. is often preferred for senior roles.
  • Certifications like Google Professional Data Scientist or AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty can enhance qualifications.

Job Description Summary

Job Description

While we prefer this role to be based in our St. Petersburg, FL office with a hybrid work arrangement, we are open to considering qualified candidates for a remote workstyle based on experience and alignment with business needs

Please note: This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future.

The People Analytics Analyst transforms HR and workforce data into strategic insights that support data‑driven business decisions. As a Qlik Sense (Qlik) analytics expert, this role designs and delivers advanced dashboards, reports, and data solutions that enable leadership to understand workforce trends, risks, and opportunities. The Analyst partners with HR leadership and business stakeholders to define workforce metrics, support strategic planning, and communicate actionable insights.

While this role is not Workday‑centric, baseline knowledge and exposure to Workday reporting is required to understand source data, validate outputs, and collaborate effectively with HR and HRIS partners. The Analyst supports project delivery through high‑quality business analysis, identifies and implements improvement initiatives, ensures data governance and compliance, and continuously enhances the organization’s people analytics capabilities. The People Analytics Analyst also coaches less experienced team members and serves as a trusted analytics advisor across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Plan all business and technical aspects of data and analytics systems and platforms, with a primary focus on Qlik Sense / Qlik Cloud.

  • Understand system features, data structures, and dependencies across HR systems, including baseline familiarity with Workday reporting outputs.

  • Own maintenance, administration, and ongoing optimization of analytics platforms and datasets.

  • Perform complex statistical analysis and apply mining, modeling, and testing techniques to enable robust data analysis.

  • Support key components of the data management ecosystem, including data pipelines, reporting layers, and analytics models.

  • Interpret business needs and translate them into actionable analytics solutions at the business unit level.

  • Lead improvement initiatives within the span of control and manage implementation through completion.

  • Contribute to the design and execution of reporting strategies and visualization standards.

  • Build and deliver complex dashboards and reports, identifying and interpreting trends and patterns in workforce data.

  • Translate analytical insights into clear, actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders.

  • Serve as the primary subject‑matter expert for Qlik analytics, dashboards, and self‑service reporting.

  • Design and manage dashboards covering headcount, turnover, talent acquisition, total rewards, and other key HR areas.

  • Support strategic workforce planning initiatives, including scenario modeling and forecasting.

  • Partner with HR, Finance, and business leaders to define workforce KPIs aligned to organizational strategy.

  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership in a clear, compelling manner.

  • Champion HR data governance standards and reporting best practices.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and data privacy requirements (e.g., EEO, GDPR, SOX).

  • Create and maintain documentation, metadata, and data dictionaries.

  • Document “as‑is” and “to‑be” processes and define analytics requirements to support future‑state capabilities.

  • Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Visier).

  • Troubleshoot data and system issues, taking ownership through resolution.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced experience with Qlik Sense / Qlik Cloud, including data modeling, scripting, dashboard development, and optimization.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel (Access a plus).

  • Experience integrating and analyzing data from HRIS, payroll, talent, and external data sources.

  • Baseline knowledge of Workday reporting, including familiarity with standard reports and HR data outputs.

  • Understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, and data validation techniques.

  • Experience with data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Visier).

  • Familiarity with statistical tools such as SPSS or SAS is a plus.

Knowledge / Skills

  • Advanced expertise in people and workforce analytics.

  • Strong understanding of HR data, metrics, and reporting standards.

  • In‑depth knowledge of HR ERP systems and analytics environments.

  • Understanding of business needs and practices within the financial services industry.

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.

  • Ability to identify, analyze, and interpret trends in complex datasets.

  • Working knowledge of basic statistical techniques (e.g., correlation, regression, T‑tests).

  • Ability to design data collection and analytics solutions that improve efficiency and data quality.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across all organizational levels.

  • Ability to act independently while providing guidance and training to others.

  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.

  • High level of customer service and stakeholder engagement.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment and adapt analytics approaches as needed.

  • Typically works independently and serves as an established analytics authority.

If you're an LPN who values autonomy, is comfortable with technology, and wants to contribute to proactive, preventive care, this is an opportunity to be part of a growing, forward-thinking team.

You will play a key role in monitoring and supporting patients managing chronic conditions—engaging them consistently and coordinating care when it matters most.

  • Monitor RPM dashboards and respond to alerts (blood pressure, glucose, weight, etc.)
  • Call patients regularly to assess symptoms and reinforce device usage
  • Coordinate follow-up with NPs, primary care providers, and caregivers
  • Document patient interactions in EMR and internal systems

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a panel of patients
  • Support patient enrollment and onboarding as needed

What Makes This Role Different

  • Focus on preventive, data-driven care rather than bedside tasks
  • Opportunity to directly impact patient outcomes and reduce hospitalizations
  • Structured, team-based environment with consistent scheduling
  • Exposure to innovative care delivery models

What We're Looking For

  • Active Virginia LPN license, preferred, or ability to quickly obtain
  • Strong clinical judgment and clear, professional phone communication skills
  • Highly organized and comfortable working across multiple platforms
  • Experience with RPM, telehealth, or care coordination preferred
  • Interest in preventive care and patient engagement
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, structured environment

Benefits

  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Referral program

If you're looking to move beyond traditional nursing roles and contribute to a more proactive approach to patient care, we encourage you to apply.

Come and push your journey to the next level!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about iGaming and tech development bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Games Mathematician.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Games Mathematician is a core member of the Immense Studio game development team, responsible for designing, validating, and documenting the mathematical frameworks that underpin our slot and casino game portfolio. This role works closely with game designers, engine developers, and third-party partners to ensure every game delivers mathematically sound, commercially viable, and regulatorily compliant outcomes.

Math design and documentation

  • Own the creation, maintenance, and governance of all game math documentation, including math models, metadata specifications, bet level structures, jackpot configurations, and RTP tables.
  • Ensure all math documentation is version-controlled, accurate, and aligned with live game behavior at all times.
  • Develop and maintain internal math design standards and templates to support consistent and efficient game production across the studio.

Verification and analysis

  • Design and build spreadsheet models and software simulations to independently verify math models — both internally developed and those supplied by third-party studios or mathematics consultants.
  • Provide formal proofs and analytical reviews of gaming math models prior to certification and release.
  • Monitor performance data from live games to validate real-world behavior against expected theoretical outcomes, flagging and investigating any deviations.

Tooling and automation

  • Build and maintain math tools and calculators to support the game design and production pipeline, including automation of repetitive calculation and verification tasks.
  • Write, test, and document code for math tooling used across the studio.

Collaboration and third-party integration

  • Partner with game designers and engine developers to ensure correct and precise implementation of math models within the game engine.
  • Support the integration and validation of third-party math models, assessing feasibility and conducting structured testing prior to adoption.
  • Act as the mathematical authority within cross-functional production teams, clearly communicating complex concepts to non-mathematical stakeholders.

Who and what we are after?

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
  • Hands-on experience designing or verifying mathematical models for casino or slot games.
  • Experience writing and testing code for mathematical tooling (Python, JavaScript, or similar).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to produce clear, precise technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and evidence-based approach to decision-making.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to build complex models and automate tasks.
  • Solid grounding in applied mathematics, probability theory, and statistical analysis, with demonstrable experience applying these in a professional context.

Nice to have

  • Experience working within a regulated iGaming environment and familiarity with RTP certification requirements across major jurisdictions.
  • Knowledge of jackpot mechanics, volatility modelling, or feature math design for video slots.
  • Exposure to game engine integration workflows and the software development lifecycle in a games studio.

Meet all the eligible criteria? Apply today and join the Immense Group team.
